Exercise: Standing Bradford Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_press

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system and glycolytic pathway

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder instability or injury
- Recent shoulder surgery

Exercise Variations:

- name: Front Raise to Overhead Press, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders', 'triceps']
- name: Arnold Press, force: push, equipment: barbell

Substitution Options:

- name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press, equipment: dumbbells
- name: Overhead Barbell Extension, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Place a loaded bar at shoulder level in a rack. With a pronated grip at shoulder width, begin with the bar racked across the front of your shoulders. This is your starting position.
- Initiate the lift by extending the elbows to press the bar overhead. Avoid locking out the elbow as you move the weight behind your head.
- Lower the bar down to the back of the head until your elbow forms a right angle.
- Lift the bar back over your head by extending the elbows
- Lower the bar down to the starting position.
- Alternate in this manner until you complete the recommended amount of repetitions.
